source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Current EnsureFolderCached fetches missing row data and returns a Result carrying failures. Its stand-in trim policy grows to 512 entries and discards an arbitrary quarter; it is not a least-recently-used cache. Mutations update existing cached data after successful SQL writes. Preserve correct DB-backed lookup when an entry is absent or evicted. This comparison does not benchmark the cache or establish cross-thread safety. Static inspection supports this component scope. No runtime test was run for this lesson, and full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion is still pending.
title: Treat the Panorama folder cache as a bounded optimization
